summary: Ontario provincial tower record named Pinetorch Fire Tower, with its point on Ishpatina Ridge; a volunteer list and a directory name an Acadia Tower at Pinetorch Lake, Temagami, an MNR repeater tower, and the two may not be the same structure.

facts.status_note: A volunteer list of still-standing towers describes it as an MNR repeater tower (Acadia Tower); no source confirms its condition today.

events.note: Construction date stored in the provincial tower layer as 1 June 1935. The layer gives no builder or purpose.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, but they do not agree on identity. The provincial record calls the structure the Pinetorch Fire Tower and ties its point to Ishpatina Ridge (within 10 m accuracy). The volunteer list calls the Pinetorch Lake structure the Acadia Tower, an MNR repeater tower, and separately lists an Ellis Tower on Ishpatina Ridge. Whether these are one structure is unresolved. The story therefore does not place the provincial record's point at Pinetorch Lake. The layer's HEIGHT_ABOVE_GROUND_NUM (80) and GROUND_ELEV_ASL_NUM (2273) carry no unit; 2273 ft matches the brief's elevation_m of 692.8, but no height_m is recorded because the unit is not stated. The construction date is stored as 1 June 1935, which may be a year-only entry, so the story gives the year only. The volunteer list is undated, so the repeater label is not dated. No source gives staffing, access level or a fire history. Visit climbable=false rests on the list's general request not to climb towers the MNR no longer maintains.
